# Auto-Interaction & Comment Mode Quality Checklist: 004-description-auto-interact

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and quality of requirements for First Comment Mode and Continuous Auto-Interaction before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact conditions for excluding creator and pinned comments specified unambiguously? [Completeness] [Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the fallback behavior clearly defined when a video has zero comments or only creator comments? [Completeness] [Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the available interval delay choices explicitly enumerated (e.g., 3s, 5s, 8s, 10s, 15s)? [Completeness] [Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the max video limit options (10, 20, 50, unlimited) clearly specified? [Completeness] [Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behavior defined when the user abruptly stops the auto-flow during an active delay countdown? [Completeness] [Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is the DOM targeting for the first audience comment quantified with specific selectors (`span[data-e2e="comment-level-1"]`)? [Clarity] [Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the down-arrow navigation mechanism explicitly detailed with primary button selector and keyboard fallback (`feed-navigation-next` / `ArrowDown`)? [Clarity] [Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the phrase "Bỏ qua ngay lập tức" (Skip immediately) quantified without delay countdown when comments are disabled? [Clarity] [Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK009 Are visual countdown timer feedback requirements specified for the Side Panel UI? [Clarity] [Spec §US3/AC2]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec define what happens when reaching the end of the feed or navigation fails? [Edge Cases] [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the spec handle the scenario where the video was already liked prior to auto-interaction? [Edge Cases] [Spec §US2/AC4]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec specify what occurs if the user navigates away or switches tabs during auto-flow? [Edge Cases] [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is behavior defined when the first comment contains excessive length (>200 chars) or special formatting? [Edge Cases] [Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency & Measurability

- [ ] CHK014 Are success criteria measurable with clear quantitative thresholds (e.g., stop response < 500ms, navigation reliability > 98%)? [Measurability] [Spec §SC-003, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Are stored settings keys (`commentMode`, `autoInteractDelay`, `maxVideos`) consistent across storage schema and functional requirements? [Consistency] [Spec §Key Entities, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Are UI state transitions between "Bắt đầu Auto" and "Dừng lại" consistent across all failure and manual stop flows? [Consistency] [Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
